requirement.value: Dancer, Fury or Mutant mastery (the Pilot route is cut)

system.description: Action: grab a willing visible ally and throw them — an Open (DEX+MIG) or (MIG+INS) Check (crits on doubles with Frenzy); the ally makes a free attack dealing extra damage equal to the Open Check's result, inflicting weak on each creature hit. On a fumble or miss the ally takes your Might die size in physical.
